subtitle: Lesson 9 · Data Types Across Dialects

caption: No true BOOLEAN column type exists in SQL Server.

eyebrow: Oracle -- traditionally no boolean column at all
code:
-- Convention #1
CREATE TABLE products (is_active CHAR(1));   -- 'Y'/'N'

-- Convention #2
CREATE TABLE products (is_active NUMBER(1)); -- 0/1
caption: PL/SQL has BOOLEAN inside code -- never traditionally for a table column.

eyebrow: MySQL -- BOOLEAN is just a disguise
caption: Check the metadata: it reports TINYINT(1), not BOOLEAN.
A genuine native boolean type, enforced by the type system.
